metrics.definition: Protected product reaches its first policy-verified successful release check within 7 days of registration
Activated protected products with at least one valid platform check on day 7
Activated protected products with at least one valid platform check on day 30
Started release, rotation, restore, or incident workflows that reach an evidence-backed terminal result
CLI or future console sessions ending without an unhandled process failure
Human support effort attributable to the platform
Confirmed malicious or policy-violating requests among evaluated privileged requests
External security, observability, CI, registry, backup, and signing cost allocated to active products
Candidate internal or subscription revenue less directly attributable platform cost
metrics.source: approved billing ledger and provider invoices

metrics.definition: Distinct product-bound public testnet sessions that complete a verified protected task
metrics.source: canonical session introspection and audit events

metrics.definition: Eligible product teams that adopt every mandatory platform gate after evaluation
Documented founder decision based on reliability, security, adoption, support, and cost guardrails
metrics.formula: scale only when SLO, restore, critical-vulnerability, adoption, support, and cost gates all pass; kill or redesign when a critical safety gate fails persistently
metrics.source: signed decision record linked to KPI evidence
